periods.time: Ikki's Osaka dinner and Moroboshi first-round match
periods.label: 重新为哥哥加油的妹妹
periods.occupation: middle-school-aged helper at family okonomiyaki restaurant

status.current: recovers her voice enough to shout encouragement to Yuudai during his match

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Elder brother; she blames herself for the accident that cost him his legs and struggles to cheer for him.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Another younger sister who understands her guilt and tells her it is acceptable to depend on an elder brother.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Customer at Ittousei and Yuudai's opponent; his victory comes after Koume's cheer gives Yuudai his final push.

periods.summary: Koume helps at the Moroboshi family's okonomiyaki shop and communicates by writing because she stopped speaking after the train accident. She had asked to go to the amusement park on the day Yuudai lost his legs, and her guilt made her lose her voice. During Yuudai's match with Ikki she cannot bear watching him be wounded for her sake and flees the stands. Shizuku follows and tells her that younger sisters are allowed to rely on their older brothers. Koume returns and shouts for Yuudai to keep fighting, the first spoken encouragement he has awaited for years.

key_events.summary: Serves Ikki's group at the family restaurant by writing in a sketchbook.
Returns to the stands and shouts encouragement to Yuudai.
